title: 第11章 丹药入肚脑袋尖尖第12章 村长交易
slug: 全民高塔开局一个神话天赋
lines: 光芒入体，吴语只感觉冰冰凉凉的十分舒服。
泡在温水之中，颇有一种冰火两重天的感觉！
吴语嘀咕了一句。
忽然！
他脑中有无数记忆浮现，如梦似幻，亦真亦假。
霎时间，吴语似乎做了一个梦。
在梦中他苦练《虎啸八斩刀》，此刀法乃是恶虎山寨的寨主日夜观摩山君，又结合了本身传承的超凡刀法所悟！
有炼精之法【虎啸刀】，只有一招，但刀刀带虎啸之音，摄人心神。最多可斩出八刀，虎啸八声，甚至能影响现实，震碎人的身体。
还有炼神之法【虎啸】，可消耗气血，发出山君怒吼！
回过神，大木桶中的水已经有些凉意了。
吴语呼出一口气，只感觉浑身有劲。
短短时间，他就从一个手无缚鸡之力的学子，变成了一个苦练刀法的武者！
“可惜只是入门，也不知圆满境界能否成为超凡生命。”
吴语摸了摸自己的手臂，发现肌肉鼓起，隐隐有狰狞之意。
又站起身来看了看，各处都有锻炼的痕迹，却没有暗伤，老茧之类的。
玄之又玄，妙不可言！
“不可思议！这和知识芯片不一样！”
吴语露出惊色。
在江城高等学府，也是有一些有钱学生的。
他们装载“知识芯片”，只要一会儿就能掌控其他人苦学多年的知识。
但......他没见过身体也会因此发生改变的！
“这只是白色品质的功法卡？”
“如果是更高品质的呢？”
吴语眼神微凝，越发感觉此地的神秘。
这是一个宝藏之地，随便一点东西都足以让他得到天大好处。
“我之前隔得远，也不知道那山贼首领是否用了《虎啸八斩刀》，但从老吴的说法来看，山寨大当家可以一跃十几米，奔跑如雷，一拳打穿铁甲！”
“就算这个古代背景的铁甲不如现代，却也是真材实料，我遇到的估摸着只是一个小头目！”
“说起来，我现在的《虎啸八斩刀》水平未必不如那小头目！”
吴语兴致勃勃，很想拿出一把刀练练。
可惜，他手里没有刀。
冷静下来后，洗澡水已经凉透了。
content_en:
As the light entered his body, Wu Yu felt very comfortable and cool.
Soaking in the warm water feels like a world of ice and fire!
"It's pretty cool..."
Wu Yu muttered.
suddenly!
Countless memories appeared in his mind, like dreams and illusions, both true and false.
For a moment, Wu Yu seemed to have a dream.
In his dream, he worked hard to practice the "Tiger Roaring Eight Cutting Sword". This sword technique was learned by the owner of the Evil Tiger Village who watched the tiger day and night, and combined it with the extraordinary sword technique he inherited!
There is a refining method [Tiger Roaring Knife], which only has one move, but the sound of the tiger's roaring sword is breathtaking. It can slash up to eight times and roar eight times, and can even affect reality and shatter people's bodies.
There is also the method of refining the gods [Tiger Roar], which can consume energy and blood and let out the roar of a tiger!
...
When he came back to his senses, the water in the big wooden barrel was already a little cool.
Wu Yu exhaled and felt energetic all over his body.
In a short period of time, he changed from a weak student to a warrior who practiced sword skills hard!
""The Roaring Tiger and the Eight Cutting Swords"..."
"It's a pity that it's just an introduction. I don't know if the perfect state can lead to an extraordinary life."
Wu Yu touched his arm and found that the muscles were bulging, vaguely ferocious.
I stood up and took a look again. There were traces of exercise everywhere, but there were no hidden wounds or calluses.
Mysterious and mysterious, wonderful beyond words!
"Incredible! This is different from the knowledge chip!"
Wu Yu looked shocked.
There are also some wealthy students in Jiangcheng University of Higher Education.
They are equipped with "knowledge chips" and can master the knowledge that others have studied hard for many years in just a moment.
But...he has never seen his body change as a result!
"Is this just a white quality skill card?"
“What if it’s higher quality?”
Wu Yu's eyes narrowed slightly, feeling more and more mysterious about this place.
This is a place of treasures, and just a little bit of it is enough to bring him great benefits.
"I was far away before, and I don't know if the bandit leader used the "Tiger's Roaring Eight-Cut Sword", but from what Old Wu said, the master of the cottage can jump more than ten meters, run like thunder, and punch through iron armor with one punch!"
"Even if the armor in this ancient setting is not as good as modern ones, it is still genuine. I think I only encountered a small boss!"
"Speaking of which, my current level of "Tiger Roaring Eight Swords" may not be as good as that little boss!"
Wu Yu was very interested and wanted to take out a knife to practice with.
Unfortunately, he didn't have a knife in his hand.
...
After calming down, the bath water was completely cold.
